🌮 NO-DOUGH CHEESE TACOS! These crispy corn wraps are SO good 🤤 Forget traditional tortillas — this taco shell is made with just corn + cheese and gets perfectly crispy in the oven! Ingredients: For the shells: 10.5 oz (300 g) canned or cooked sweet corn, drained 3.5 oz (100 g) shredded cheese For the filling: Cream cheese Ham Tomato Fresh herbs How to make them: Spread the corn into circles on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Sprinkle generously with shredded cheese. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15–20 minutes, until golden and crispy. Let them cool slightly, then carefully remove from the parchment. Fill with cream cheese, ham, tomato and fresh herbs. Fold in half and enjoy! ✨ Crispy, cheesy, easy and SO satisfying! This one is a super easy dinner recipe the whole family enjoys! Using rotisserie chicken makes this recipe even easier.  I’ll be posting easy dinners every day for the month of August! Make sure to let me know what meals would be helpful to your family.  Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Bake INGREDIENTS  1 lb of Cellentani Pasta  1 lb cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken) 15 oz jar of Alfredo Sauce 1 Ranch seasoning packet  1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 6 pieces of cooked and crumbled bacon Parsley INSTRUCTIONS  Cook at least 6 pieces of bacon and chop into small pieces. Boil one pound of pasta according to the directions on the package. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Pour the cooked pasta into the bottom of the baking dish. Add about 1 lb of rotisserie chicken, one jar of Alfredo sauce, and a ranch seasoning packet. Add some of the mozzarella, cheddar cheese, and some of the bacon and stir everything together well.  Top with a little bit more cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, and crumbled bacon. Bake at 375 degrees F for about 15-20 minutes. Serve and enjoy! #easyrecipes #easydinners #chicken

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Zdecydowanie jeden z tych przepisów, które warto zapisać! Zapisz i wyślij komuś, z kim zjadłbyś całą patelnię! #food #foodtok #cooking #recipe #dumplings

Banana pudding crème brûlée stuffed French toast! A recipe from @Sarah Sweets  Ingredients: Instant Banana pudding mix (family size 5.1oz) 2 cups cold milk Mixture: 3 eggs 1/4 cup milk 1 tsp vanilla extract  1/4 cup sugar 12 pack kings hawaiian rolls 3 tbsp salted butter  6 crushed vanilla wafers  Crème brule sugar: 1 cup water  1 cup sugar  How to: In a bowl whisk banana pudding mix with milk. Place in the fridge to thicken up. In a bowl combine eggs, milk, vanilla extract and sugar. Mix well with a fork. Place butter in a pan and turn onto medium heat. Once butter is melted separate rolls and dip into the egg mixture coating all sides. Place in the pan and cook on all sides until golden brown until all are cooked. Next add pudding mix into a piping bag. On the sides of the rolls use a straw to hollow each one out so that you can fit the piping bag into it. Stuff each roll with banana puffing mixture.  In a sauce pan add water and sugar. Place on high heat (no need to stir) until it’s a light golden brown color. Take off the heat. Carefully dip the top of each roll into the sugar and place on parchment paper. Top with a few crushed vanilla wafers immediately. Serve!  #frenchtoast #desserts #banana #howto #breakfast

Viral Chocolate box cake✨🍫🍰 #yellowboxcake #bettycrocker #yellowcakechocolatefrosting #boxcake #dessert Ingredients: • 1 box Betty Crocker Yellow Cake Mix or Butter Recipe Yellow Cake mix  • 4 eggs • 1 stick unsalted butter, melted • 1 cup buttermilk or milk • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1 container Betty Crocker Hershey’s Chocolate Frosting Instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the Betty Crocker Yellow Cake Mix, 4 eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla extract. 2. Mix until smooth and well combined. 3. Pour the batter into a greased 9x11 baking pan. 4. Bake at 315°F for 37 minutes. 5. Let the cake cool completely. 6. Microwave the Betty Crocker Hershey’s Chocolate Frosting for 15–20 seconds until pourable (warm, not hot). 7. Pour the frosting over the cake, making sure to cover all the corners evenly. 8. Let the frosting set for 1–2 hours. 9. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

Who else lives olives? 🫒 Recipe -  Olive and Garlic Cream Cheese Buns  / Ingredients: For the dough: - 350g all purpose flour (2 cups + 3/4 cup + 1 tablespoon) - 35g granulated sugar (3 tablespoons) - 7g instant dry yeast  (1 packet) - 7g fine sea salt (1 teaspoon + 1/4 teaspoon) - 50g unsalted butter, melted and cooled (3 tablespoons + 1 teaspoon) - 1 large egg - 150g warm milk  (1/2 cup + 2 tablespoons) - 100g grated Cheddar Cheese (1 cup) - 100g grated Emmentaler Cheese (1 cup) For the filling: - 200g Chive Philadelphia Cream Cheese - Green Olives - Kalamata Olives - Grated Emmentaler Cheese  - An egg, for an egg wash - Microgreens, for toppings Instructions: 1. To the bowl of your stand mixer, add the flour, salt, sugar, instant dry yeast, grated Cheddar and grated Emmentaler cheese. Whisk everything together. 2. Next, add the milk, egg and melted butter. 3. Using the dough hook attachment, knead on low speed until the dough becomes smooth and forms a ball, about 6-8 minutes. 4. Once ready, transfer the dough to a clean, lightly oiled bowl. 5. Cover and let it rise at room temperature for 2 hours. 6. After 2 hours, punch the dough down and divide it into 8 equal balls, about 105 g each. 7. Place them on a large baking tray lined with parchment paper, cover and let them rise for another 1 hour. 8. Preheat the oven to 180°C. 9. Brush each bun with the egg wash. 10. Fill each bun with a little cream cheese and top with the olives. 11. Sprinkle with more grated cheese. 12. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the buns are golden brown. 13. Once ready, top with microgreens and serve warm. #bread #breakfastrecipes #foodtok #asmr #baking

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

F*CK or SUCK  Crispy Rice Tuna Salad 👨‍🍳 Ingredients, makes 4 serves For the Crispy Rice ✅ Cooked Day Old Rice, 300g, 10.6oz ✅ Soy Sauce, 15ml, 1 tbsp ✅ Avocado Oil, 10ml, 2 tsp For the Dressing ✅ Fresh Ginger, grated, 5g, 0.2oz ✅ Garlic, 2 cloves ✅ Honey, 20g, 0.7oz ✅ Rice Vinegar, 5ml, 1 tsp ✅ Sesame Oil, 15ml, 1 tbsp ✅ Light Mayonnaise, 30g, 1.1oz ✅ Soy Sauce, 30ml, 2 tbsp ✅ Water, 30ml, 2 tbsp For the Salad ✅ Tuna in Springwater, drained, 285g, 10oz ✅ Cucumber, 300g, 10.6oz ✅ Carrots, 150g, 5.3oz ✅ Avocado, 150g, 5.3oz ✅ Green Onions, sliced, to taste ✅ Sesame Seeds, optional, to serve 👉 Method 1. Mix the cooked rice with 15ml soy sauce and avocado oil. 2. Spread over a lined baking tray and bake at 190°C / 375°F until golden and crispy, tossing halfway through. 3. Add the ginger, garlic, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, light mayo, remaining soy sauce and water to a jar. Shake until combined. 4. Add the tuna, cucumber, carrot, avocado and green onions to a large bowl. 5. Add the crispy rice and pour over the dressing. 6. You’ve got a rich brownie base, a creamy cheesecake center, and a chocolate layer right on top. These are a little more dense than your traditional brownie cheesecake bar, but made with better-for-you ingredients, incredibly satisfying, and SO GOOD. Big thanks to @nora.dora99 for this amazing recipe! Here’s how to make them: FOR THE BROWNIE BASE: 150g almond flour 30g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 3 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Splash of vanilla extract Mix everything together until you have a brownie batter. Press it firmly into a parchment-lined loaf pan or small baking dish and freeze for 10 mins. FOR THE CHEESECAKE LAYER: 250g fat-free cream cheese (regular works too!) 10g sweetener of choice Splash of vanilla extract Squeeze of lemon juice I processed this in a food processor, but you can also use a hand mixer. FOR THE CHOCOLATE TOPPING: 40g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Mix until smooth, spread it over the cheesecake layer, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. This app makes organizing recipes 100% easier 🫶🏼 Ingredients: • ½ + ⅓ cup warm whole milk (heat about 45 seconds) • ¼ cup sugar • 2¼ tsp active dry yeast • 1 egg, room temp • 1 tbsp pure vanilla extract • 2½ cups bread flour • 1¼ tsp salt • ¼ cup softened unsalted butter Topping: • Honey drizzle • Powdered sugar, sifted Instructions: 	1. In a bowl combine warm milk, sugar, and yeast. Let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy. 	2. Add egg and vanilla, whisk until combined. Add bread flour and salt, mix until a shaggy dough forms. Add softened butter and knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. 	3. Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours or until doubled in size. Then refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight.  	4. Roll dough out on a floured surface to about ½ inch thick. Cut into squares. Cover and let rest 20–30 minutes until slightly puffy. 	5. Heat oil to 350°F. Fry beignets in batches until golden brown on both sides. Remove and drain on a rack. 	6. Drizzle with honey and generously sift powdered sugar over the top. Serve warm and enjoy :)  #beignets #princessandthefrog #bakingrecipe #recipe #fyp

If you’ve been craving a rich, creamy, restaurant-style pasta that still feels easy enough for a weeknight, this Creamy Garlic Tomato Rigatoni is the one. Just a creamy tomato sauce that clings beautifully to every piece of rigatoni. I served it with a fresh simple salad on the side, and it makes the whole dinner feel complete. Creamy pasta, fresh salad, extra Parmesan, and that cozy homemade flavor everyone loves.
